entities.summary: Frederick Opare-Ansah is an Electrical Engineer and Ghanaian politician who was a member of the Fourth to Seventh Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the peole of Suhum Constituency in the Eastern Region on the ticket of the New Patriotic Party (NPP).
